---
agent: Instructions Generator
---
Take the provided information about a layer of architecture or coding standards and generate a detailed instructions file in .md markdown format suitable for inclusion in the /docs directory of a repository. If the provided information is too broad, break it down into multiple focused .md files, each covering a specific aspect. Ensure each file has a clear title, purpose, and structured sections for easy navigation. Use markdown best practices, including headings, lists, and code blocks where appropriate. If a .md file already exists for a given topic, update it with any new relevant information rather than creating a duplicate. if the .md filename is not provided, create one based on the generated content's focus. Make sure instructions are clear, concise, actionable, tailored to the repository's context and not too long. Make sure to update the AGENTS.md file to reference the new .md files. If no information is provided, prompt the user to supply the necessary details about the layer of architecture or coding standards before proceeding. Ensure to search the web and relevant documentation to gather accurate and up-to-date information as needed to avoid using outdated or incorrect practices or configuration files, dependencies, code snippets, or instructions.
